name: CachyOS Kernel
description: Pros: a snappier, gaming-tuned kernel (EEVDF/BORE plus the sched-ext scheduler, LTO/PGO, ntsync for Proton). Cons: adds the CachyOS repo and signing key, rebuilds your DKMS modules (NVIDIA and the like) per kernel, and tracks a more bleeding-edge kernel. Your stock Arch kernel stays installed as the default, safe fallback: pick it at the boot menu to roll back anytime.

items.name: linux-cachyos
items.summary: The CachyOS kernel: EEVDF/BORE plus sched-ext, LTO/PGO, desktop and gaming tuned. Built for x86-64-v3.

items.name: linux-cachyos-headers
items.summary: Headers for the CachyOS kernel, needed to rebuild DKMS modules (NVIDIA, VirtualBox) against it.
